description: The company's latest filed accounts read into plain figures, this year and last. From Companies House's tagged (iXBRL) accounts document - net assets, current assets, cash, debtors, creditors due within and after a year, equity, turnover and profit where the accounts include them, average employees, for the current and prior period; audit status, standards, dormant flag; what the accounts leave out. Accounts filed as a PDF can't be read and the call's credits go back.
name: accounts
title: Filed Accounts
